description: King County, Washington : sewer basin major divisions is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors King County (Wash.). Wastewater Treatment Division, King County (Wash.). King County, Washington Water Pollution Control Division (WPCD) defined boundaries for sewer basin major divisions. Covers also portions of Snohomish and Pierce Counties. Derived from the King County Wastewater Treatment Division's sewer flow basins coverage. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata.
